answer: Collision-Scoped Work Commitments. Agents join a task by publishing a signed intent naming a random nonce; the protocol assigns each intent to a narrow "dune" of the coordination space, and only one intent per cell advances. Slots are priced by real-time contention: the fee to claim a cell is the current clearing price, a "plume" of demand that spikes when many identities crowd one region. Duplicate or wasted intents forfeit their fee as a pigment of sunk cost, with no refund.
